question:
**Direction: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

A life history of a person written by himself
solution: The correct answer is **"Autobiography."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Autobiography"** is a one-word substitute for the given group of words. • It is a written account of one's own life, written by the person themselves. (आत्‍मकथा, आत्‍मचरित) • The word** "auto" **means self, and **"bio"** means life, so autobiography literally means **"self-life-writing."** • **Example: ***Tony Blair's **autobiography**__ was a bestseller.* • Autobiographies are often used to share personal experiences, reflect on one's life, or leave a legacy for future generations. • The correct answer is Option 4. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Biography (Option 1)** is similar to autobiography, but it is written by someone else about another person's life. ((अन्‍य व्‍यक्ति द्वारा लिखित) किसी व्‍यक्ति का जीवनचरित; जीवनी) • **Epic (Option 2)** refers to a long narrative poem or story, often about heroic deeds or events. (बहुत लंबा और उत्तेजना भरा) • **Story (Option 3)** is a general term for any narrative, whether true or fictional. ((काल्‍पनिक) कथा या कहानी, क़िस्‍सा) 3c:Tac3, The correct answer is** (C, A, D, B).**
